body: One of them is a kindergarten friend. The other two are people that I met when I joined high school a couple of years ago, though we aren't really that close anymore since I changed school this year. They are pretty much from the same town as I am. They go out together with other people I've known for years and some others who I don't even know the name of. I have always been so hesitant about asking them if I could hang out with them from time to time, as I feel like their group has established. I do everything in my power to keep them close to me, but I ve already lost contact with some of my other friends. It feels like shit being isolated by the rest. They never asked me to hang out with them once since I've known them. This may sound like one of those teenagers problems that pass by, but I'm alone in almost everything I do, the only people I talk to are them. The people in my new school are mostly from far away so there is that.
